title: Ordinary constructible realization for the locally finite algebraic adic coefficient sheaf
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, its algebraic closure $k$, and $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$. Write $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. For each finite-type $k$-scheme $T$, on its small pro-etale site put $B_T=\Omega_T^{\mathrm{lf}}$, the sheaf of continuous $\Omega$-valued functions whose values locally span a finite-dimensional $\mathbf Q_\ell$-space. Put $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}(B_T)$, with the internal-module convention of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], and let $\mathcal C_T\subset D(\mathcal A_T)$ be the full subcategory with bounded constructible cohomology: each cohomology sheaf is locally finite free on every member of a finite locally closed stratification, locally on $T$. Let $\mathcal C^{\mathrm{stage}}_{T,\Omega}=D^b_{ctf}(T,\Omega)$ be the ordinary common finite coefficient-field category of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]: objects are represented over one finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\Omega$, and morphisms are the filtered colimit of the scalar-extended Hom groups over common finite extensions. At $E$ use raw rationalization of derived-complete integral constructible complexes [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. On an integral representative $K_E$ over $R=\mathcal O_E$, put $B_{T,E}=\varprojlim_n(R/\varpi_E^n)_T$ and $E_T=B_{T,E}[1/\varpi_E]$. There is a natural map $E_T\to B_T$. The formula
$$J_T(K_E[1/\varpi_E])=B_T\otimes^L_{B_{T,E}}K_E$$
and scalar extension on morphisms defines an equivalence of ordinary triangulated categories
$$J_T:\mathcal C^{\mathrm{stage}}_{T,\Omega}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal C_T.$$
Here realization of a fractional morphism multiplies its realized numerator by the same inverse uniformizer power; passage to a common finite field uses balanced scalar extension. Both categories are essentially small in the common site/coefficient universe [def-weil-size-convention]. The assertion includes full faithfulness on derived morphisms, not just equivalence of hearts. It does not identify any individual finite-$E$ category with $\mathcal C_T$.

proof.text: The hypotheses needed for the coefficient comparisons hold without separatedness. The one-point scheme $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is Noetherian: its only affine coordinate ring is the field $k$, whose ideals are $0$ and $k$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] to $T\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ to obtain Noetherian $T$, hence quasi-compact and locally Noetherian. Its Krull dimension is finite by [lem-kun-dimension-finite-type]. The nonzero element $\ell\in k$ is invertible and its inverse maps into every local ring of $T$. Every locally closed stratum remains Noetherian, finite dimensional and has $\ell$ invertible. Thus all subsequent uses of the finite-field realization meet their geometric hypotheses.
